name: Mcp Amplenote
description: Connect Claude Code to your Amplenote account and manage notes without leaving your workflow. Supports creating notes with tags, reading full note content, updating or deleting notes, inserting paragraphs and checkbox tasks, searching by title or tag, and filtering by tag or timestamp. OAuth tokens are automatically refreshed on expiry and saved back to your config file. Credentials are loaded from a JSON config file (compatible with the standard api-amplenote.json format) or direct environment variables.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `amplenote`.

Installs with `claude plugin install mcp-amplenote@claude-community` from `adourish/mcp-amplenote`.

Connect Claude Code to your Amplenote account and manage notes without leaving your workflow. Supports creating notes with tags, reading full note content, updating or deleting notes, inserting paragraphs and checkbox tasks, searching by title or tag, and filtering by tag or timestamp. OAuth tokens are automatically refreshed on expiry and saved back to your config file. Credentials are loaded from a JSON config file (compatible with the standard api-amplenote.json format) or direct environment variables.
